name: Searching
overview: Scripture reveals that searching is a vital spiritual pursuit characterized by earnest seeking and reliance on God. Those who seek God early and prioritize His kingdom and righteousness are promised to find Him and receive their needs (Proverbs 8:17; Matthew 6:33). The act of searching extends to the Scriptures themselves, which testify of Christ and guide believers to eternal life (John 5:39). Ultimately, faith in Jesus as the resurrection and the life assures that those who believe will live, underscoring the life-transforming power found in genuine seeking (John 11:25).
